change: expand the industry universe from 10 to 18 pure-tech SW2 industries and set k by percentile (deltaC top 5 of 18 = 28%, RV top 3 of 18 = 17%)

unchanged.pca: 125d window, half-life 125d, 2 components, sqrt float-mv weighting
unchanged.timing: deltaAR(1.5) hysteresis x TIP 21/63/126/252 calendar gate, next-day effect

execution.etf_selection: per industry, 250d correlation vs industry index, corr >= 0.80, top 8 by correlation, then rank by 0.5*beta_rank + 0.5*HA77_composite_rank

required_checks: single-period dependence test: gain must not be confined to 2025-2026
decision_rule: adopt only if the 2019-2023 segment Sharpe is at least the 10-industry baseline and the yearly gain is positive in at least half of the years
known_limitations: new industries have few members (digital media 14, electronic chemicals 38)
ETF execution relies on the frozen HA composite for ranking
